name: Kelden Hardknee Courier Trouser
description:
Mid-weight cargo pants with visibly reinforced knees in a darker tone of the same base fabric — a functional design choice that's become something of a courier style signature. Available in charcoal, rust brown, and washed black. Slim-straight cut, articulated knee panels, and a triple-stitched seat.

Standard issue for bike and foot couriers citywide, though plenty of people wear them off the job. The knee reinforcement holds up to years of kneeling on concrete, crouching on rooftops, and sliding across wet pavement. Cheap enough to replace when they finally wear out.
functionality: Reinforced articulated knee panels, triple-stitched seat, four cargo pockets, belt loop layout supports messenger bag hip belt
what_it_says: You're on the move constantly and you dress for what your body actually does.
story_hooks: A courier's regular client starts requesting the same rider every time — they've been studying the wear patterns on their pants to track their routes.
A knockoff version floods the Shelf market, but the knee panels are painted on, not structural — bad news for anyone who trusts them.
